message:
Deploy the web build to GitHub Pages

.github/workflows/pages.yml runs the full test pipeline on every push
to main, exports the single-threaded Web preset with Godot 4.3 (only
the web_nothreads templates are kept from the release archive, and
both downloads are cached) and publishes build/web through
actions/deploy-pages. It can also be started by hand.

build/.gdignore is now tracked so Godot never imports exported files
back into the project, where the next export would pack them. README
gains the play link, web export steps and the browser LLM note;
CLAUDE.md documents the workflow and the single-threaded constraint.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01TC2aQyq7b2eKKyzgPdR2Yf

Vary the opening crisis cards

Only FRONTIER_RELEASE_RACE was eligible in 2026, so every campaign
opened with the same card seven turns running. Chip export controls
(tension >= 35), grid brownouts (compute >= 45) and interpretability
claims (from 2027) now join the opening pool. A card waiting to return
escalated after a deferral is no longer drawn fresh in the meantime.

Monte Carlo (240 runs) stays within seed noise: on 250 fresh CEO seeds
victories go 64 -> 67 and convergence 44.8% -> 37.6%. The balance
snapshot in docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md is refreshed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01TC2aQyq7b2eKKyzgPdR2Yf

Skip the localhost LLM probe in web builds and stop importing docs

A page served from GitHub Pages must not reach into the visitor's local
network on load: browsers show permission prompts and the request fails
CORS anyway. LLMService.should_auto_probe() now gates the startup probe
and the periodic re-probe; web builds skip them for the default
localhost endpoint, while the settings dialog still probes on Test and
Save. docs/.gdignore keeps the README screenshots out of the Godot
import, so their .import files are gone.

Add docs, CI, export presets and ASI economy tweak

- README: quick start, controls, testing/tooling, LLM configuration
  (Ollama, vLLM, Claude via OpenAI-compatible endpoint), architecture,
  PRD milestone status, design notes and credits
- docs/SIMULATION_MODEL.md: coupled equations, compute physics, tech tree,
  factions, termination rules, endgame matrix and balance snapshot
- CLAUDE.md: agent workflow, architecture rules, extension recipes and
  the Godot 4.3 gotchas encountered while building
- .github/workflows/ci.yml: headless suite on Godot 4.3 and 4.7
- export_presets.cfg: Linux, Windows, macOS (universal) and Web
  (no-threads) presets; enable ETC2/ASTC import for macOS
- Soften enforcement drain on ASI objective coherence so an ASI player
  is not locked out of every directive; SYNAPSE_LLM_JSON_MODE env var

Verified: tools/run_tests.sh passes on Godot 4.3, 4.4.1, 4.6 and 4.7.

Balance the macro model and add Monte Carlo tooling

- Rework labor/autonomy targets: gentler capability curves with brakes
  from enforcement, trust, safety nets and community opt-out
- Regime self-reinforcement for trust, autonomy and tension so runs
  diverge toward distinct end-states instead of one equilibrium
- Victory matrix: per-condition normalized shortfall, nearest attractor
  restricted to entered regimes, catastrophe-consistent end-states;
  convergence catastrophe needs two consecutive turns (red alert first)
- Rebalanced ASI discovery/substrate economy, CEO distillation cadence,
  governance de-escalation, demand elasticity and era grid growth
- tools/monte_carlo.gd balance report and tests/unit/test_balance.gd
  guardrails; refreshed screenshots in docs/screenshots

Add LLM layer, cyber-telemetry dashboard and 3D viewports

Milestones 3-5 of the PRD:

- systems/llm/llm_service.gd: OpenAI-compatible HTTPRequest client with
  5 s timeout, schema validation, circuit breaker and transparent
  HeuristicFallback; config from project settings, user:// and env vars
- systems/llm/prompt_templates.gd: role personas, catalog-aware system
  prompts, JSON extraction and strict validation of untrusted output
- ui/: runtime Cyber-Telemetry theme (JetBrains Mono + Inter, OFL),
  main_dashboard.tscn with meters, directive panel, crisis card dialog,
  LLM status badge, event feed, role select, LLM settings and endgame
  debrief with trajectory chart and end-state affinities
- viewports_3d/: holographic globe (Natural Earth land dots, datacenter
  heat, cable throughput, embargo rings, wireframe shader) and neural
  lattice (force-directed graph, drift-driven glow/jitter shader, loss
  landscape), shared orbit camera
- tests: mock OpenAI server over TCPServer, LLM service and prompt suites,
  headless dashboard smoke tests; tools/check_scripts.gd lint step and
  screenshot capture tools

Add headless simulation core, faction layer and heuristic AI

Milestones 1-2 of the SYNAPSE-2076 PRD (Godot 4.3+, GDScript):

- project.godot (GL Compatibility renderer, synapse/* settings)
- core/world_state.gd: six normalized macro metrics, secondary indices
  and the coupled 6-month difference equations
- core/simulation_engine.gd: four-phase turn state machine with signals,
  async decision-provider hook, player submissions and endgame checks
- core/tech_tree_manager.gd + systems/compute_scaling.gd: scaling laws,
  thermal walls, eras, paradigm shifts, emergence and alignment tax
- core/victory_matrix.gd: the eight end-states plus role verdicts
- entities/: actor base and the four asymmetric factions
- systems/llm/heuristic_fallback.gd: deterministic decision trees
- systems/dilemma_deck.gd: procedural crisis cards with injection,
  deferral and escalation
- tests/: zero-dependency headless runner, unit suites, PRD
  headless_sim_test.gd; tools/run_tests.sh wrapper
